title: 可搬式オープンフレーム発電機
description: 工事区画や屋外作業場に置く汎用の小型発電機。保護フレーム、防振脚、燃料タンク、フィン付き原動機、発電部とコンセント付き操作面を造形。ケーブル、電力供給、燃料・排気の動作は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.760 × 0.610 × 0.552 m、18,860三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A generic compact generator for construction compounds and outdoor work areas. Models the roll cage, anti-vibration feet, fuel tank, finned engine, alternator and outlet control panel. Cables, power supply, fuel and exhaust simulation are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.760 × 0.610 × 0.552 m; 18,860 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
